violated_contract: A cache value that multiple independent writers merge into -- each request reads the whole blob, edits only its own entry, and writes the whole blob back -- must serialize that read-modify-write. Otherwise two writers racing on the same key silently drop whichever entry the losing writer's SET overwrote, indistinguishable from a successful write, and nothing detects or heals the loss.
canonical_prevention: Perform the merge as a single atomic server-side operation (a Lua script, or a per-field command such as HSET) instead of a GET-modify-SET in the caller, so no writer's read can observe a value another writer is about to overwrite.
